resume.headline: AI/ML Engineer
resume.summary: AI/ML Engineer with 4+ years of experience across data engineering and applied AI, building LLM applications with structured outputs, tool-using agents, and evaluation harnesses on the OpenAI SDK. Built a repository-aware assistant grounding 3 LLMs in static code analysis and benchmarked 2 agent SDKs for a co-authored paper. Holds an M.S. in Applied Computer Science and DP-203 and AWS Cloud Practitioner certifications.

bullets.label: Production Application
bullets.text: Delivers a production inventory application end to end with AI-assisted development, from Supabase PostgreSQL schema design to a deployed JavaScript dashboard on Vercel.

bullets.label: Data Modeling
bullets.text: Models append-only count history with triggers, indexes, and row-level security, replacing 7 paper and spreadsheet logs with one authenticated source of record.

bullets.label: Reorder Logic
bullets.text: Implements parsing logic that normalizes free-form counts against par levels and routes unparseable values to a manual-review queue, keeping reorder alerts trustworthy.

bullets.label: Codebase Assistant
bullets.text: Architected CodeRepoReader AI, a repository-aware assistant that accepts uploads or GitHub URLs, analyzes project structure, and answers developer questions with GPT-4o, GPT-4o Mini, and Llama 3.1 70B.

bullets.label: Context Grounding
bullets.text: Grounded model answers in static analysis, parsing 4 languages with Python AST and regex to extract classes, functions, dependencies, and entry points as structured context.

bullets.label: Agent Workflows
bullets.text: Built an event-driven CLI agent on the GitHub Copilot SDK with streaming sessions that clones repositories, collects key files, and generates beginner-friendly codebase summaries.

bullets.label: SDK Benchmarking
bullets.text: Benchmarked 2 agent SDKs on context handling, tool integration, and response quality, and co-authored the comparative research paper on the results.

bullets.label: Serverless Deployment
bullets.text: Ported the Flask service to the OpenAI SDK and deployed it on Vercel serverless functions, adding a per-session analysis cache so follow-up questions skip repeated scans.

bullets.label: Data Foundations
bullets.text: Engineered Azure Data Factory and Databricks PySpark pipelines consolidating 40+ regional SQL Server sources into Snowflake datasets covering roughly 5 million records for analytics.

bullets.label: Reconciliation Automation
bullets.text: Automated source-to-target validation and reconciliation between raw and curated layers, reducing recurring reporting errors by more than 90% across published datasets.

bullets.label: Telemetry Standardization
bullets.text: Standardized device identifiers, timestamps, and capacity units with PySpark across raw, validated, and curated S3 layers, producing consistent inputs for forecasting and analysis.

bullets.label: Production Reliability
bullets.text: Monitored pipeline runs with Amazon CloudWatch alerts and retries, tracing schema changes and source outages to restore affected deliveries with validated outputs.

bullets.label: Forecasting Datasets
bullets.text: Prepared historical utilization datasets for forecasting and scenario analysis, informing capacity recommendations that reduced storage-related escalations by 25%.

bullets.label: Structured Generation
bullets.text: Designed a 4-stage LLM pipeline on the OpenAI SDK with JSON Schema structured outputs for role analysis, resume generation, critic review, and outreach.

bullets.label: Output Guardrails
bullets.text: Enforced deterministic quality gates that reject unsupported numbers, metrics claimed by the wrong role, and tools without evidence, keeping generated claims traceable to source facts.

bullets.label: LLM Evaluation
bullets.text: Evaluated outputs across 20 labeled job descriptions with automated metrics and an LLM recruiter-judge rubric scoring role fit, technical soundness, and honesty.

bullets.label: Model Explainability
bullets.text: Combined SHAP feature attributions with Anchor rule-based explanations to show both the global drivers and the local decision rules behind each model prediction.

bullets.label: AI Governance
bullets.text: Documented model behavior and limitations against NIST AI RMF, giving technical and nontechnical reviewers a consistent basis for trusting model outputs.

emails.subject: Generative AI Engineer | grounded LLM apps and evaluation
emails.body:
Hi Hiring Team,
Greetings of the day.

I am Vamshi Krishna, an AI/ML Engineer with over four years of experience across data engineering and applied AI, building LLM applications with structured outputs and evaluation harnesses. I hold a master's degree in Applied Computer Science and am interested in the Generative AI Engineer position at Clearwater Legal Tech.

At Northwest Missouri State University, I built CodeRepoReader AI, which grounds GPT-4o and Llama answers in static code analysis, and benchmarked 2 agent SDKs for a co-authored paper. I also built ApplyForge, a 4-stage OpenAI pipeline with JSON Schema outputs, guardrails, and an evaluation suite over 20 labeled inputs. Before that, I spent three years at DXC Technology building the data pipelines these systems depend on. This experience aligns with your focus on grounded LLM features and rigorous evaluation of accuracy and groundedness.

I have attached my resume for your consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to learn more about this role and your team, and I look forward to hearing from you regarding the next steps in the hiring process.

Best regards,
Vamshi Krishna Balupari
